value:
BOUNDARY EXTENSION AND SCOPE CLOSURE for claim.law.pointer-decl-order-flips-addrlo-inplace-vs-fresh-destination.20260901.v1 (the decl-order lever). Three measured findings; the net effect is that the lever's remaining population is EMPTY and the sweep lane built on it is closed.

FINDING 1 - THE LEVER'S CLASS (b) AND THE P=40 ROSTER ARE NEARLY DISJOINT, SO 'SWEEP THE LEVER OVER P' IS NOT A COHERENT INSTRUCTION. The P=40 roster of claim.law.addrlo-home-copy-class-is-general-temp-and-shadow-coupled.20260901.v1 is produced by addrlo_home_general_census.py, whose shape-B detector REQUIRES the copy's final destination to be callee-saved (`m2.group(1) in CS`). P is therefore by construction the lever law's class (a) -- the destination-callee-saved class that same law marks S=0, source-unreachable, do-not-probe. Censusing class (b) directly (destination VOLATILE) over the same 2983 paired functions gives L=9 functions carrying an in-place/fresh divergence. Of the 40 functions in P, exactly TWO (combat::PlayerStartMissile, pmotion::PlayerMotion) appear in L; the other 38 carry no class-(b) site at all, and 7 of the 9 L members are absent from P entirely. A sweep executed as literally specified would have probed 38 functions the lever cannot reach and missed 7 of the 9 it can.

FINDING 2 - THE AXIS IS BIDIRECTIONAL, UNLIKE CLASS (a). Class (a)'s signature result was S=0 over 953 opportunities, i.e. strictly one-directional, which is what justified reading it as allocator-internal. Class (b) is not one-directional: pairing per (function, symbol), ours folds in place where the target writes fresh at 9 sites (L), and the target folds in place where we write fresh at 21 sites (I). Instance totals: IN_PLACE/VOL target 976 vs ours 962; FRESH/VOL target 1416 vs ours 1489; FRESH/CS target 920 vs ours 887; IN_PLACE/CS is 0 on both sides (a callee-saved register is never the @ha temp). The two-way divergence is consistent with class (b) being source-reachable, which is why decl order moves it at all.

FINDING 3 - THE DECISIVE ONE: THE IN-PLACE FORM IS NOT ITSELF A DEFECT, AND AFTER THE COST TEST THE LEVER POPULATION IS EMPTY. Folding the low half onto the @ha temp costs nothing unless it FORCES a copy because that register is wanted elsewhere. audio/sndfx::sndFxInitVoices is the clean counterexample: target `lis r4,sAudioState@ha ; addi r5,r4,@lo` (FRESH) versus ours `lis r5,sAudioState@ha ; addi r5,r5,@lo` (IN_PLACE) -- both land the base in r5, both are 43 instructions, and the two lines differ only in a register field. Its real 22 residual is entirely structural and unrelated (`add`+`stw` versus `addi`+`stwx`, an indexed-store idiom, three times). Adding the cost test -- keep a site only if a copy sourced from the folded register follows on our side and not the target's -- reduces L=9 to L-PAID=0. NOT ONE FUNCTION IN THE IMAGE currently pays a copy for an in-place fold that the target avoids. Instruction deltas corroborate: of the 9, four have FEWER instructions than the target (AudioLoadPart 166/167, do_shopping_8009AA48 867/870, PlayerMotion 4768/4775, ResolveWorldData 1805/1807) and so cannot carry a surplus copy, three are equal (sndFxInitVoices 43, player_store_in_save 131, shop_show_final_stats 272, init_player_change 78), and only PlayerStartMissile is longer (475/470) from unrelated structural work. POSITIVE CONTROL, so the null is not a tool artifact: restoring init_player_change's pre-fix declaration order (`pl; i; p;`) reproduces real 45 with 79 instructions against the target's 78 and one surplus `addi`, and the census then reports L-PAID=1 naming exactly ui/select::init_player_change on gPlayers; restoring the fixed order returns L-PAID=0.

DISPOSITION. init_player_change was the ONLY instance of the paid class in the image and it is already closed. The lever remains valid where its precondition recurs -- ours folds in place, the target writes a fresh VOLATILE destination, AND a copy is actually paid -- so keep the cost test in any future roster; but there is no sweep to run today, and any future 'extra address copy' residual should be screened with addrlo_inplace_census.py's L-PAID population rather than with P.
